register.labelZh: SWEEP 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: SWEEP 片語動詞可以分別表達清掃整個房間、掃起污垢,以及把物件從表面掃走。；sweep somebody along 或 away 可以描述某人深受氣氛感染;sweep somebody off their feet 則可以表示某人迅速墮入愛河。；SWEEP 可以描述球隊輕易擊敗對手、洪水沖走物件,或某人完全不理會反對意見。；這些表達常見於日常對話、故事、體育報道,以及有關暴風雨或洪水的描述。
register.summaryEn: SWEEP expressions can distinguish between cleaning a whole room, collecting dirt and removing something from a surface. Sweep somebody along or away can describe being strongly affected by an atmosphere, while sweep somebody off their feet describes suddenly falling deeply in love. SWEEP can describe a team defeating an opponent easily, a flood carrying something away or a person refusing to consider an objection. These expressions often appear in conversations, stories, sports reports and descriptions of storms or floods.
